Kyra Health | Senior & Staff Product Engineers | Remote (USA)

We’re building a national ICHRA platform at the intersection of healthcare, fintech, compliance, and AI.

Implementation is getting cheaper. Engineering judgment is not.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy:

* Turning ambiguous problems into production systems. * Owning outcomes, not tickets. * Working across product, architecture, and implementation. * Reviewing and improving AI-generated code. * Shipping quickly without creating a maintenance disaster.

Requirements:

* Strong Python, TypeScript, or equivalent experience. * Strong engineering judgment. * Strong communication skills. * US residency.

Apply: https://engineering.kyra.health

Questions: n@kyra.health
